name: Audio
description: Trim and convert audio clips in your browser.

audio-trim.name: Audio Trimmer
audio-trim.description: Cut a clip out of any audio file and save it as WAV — entirely on your device.

waveform-view.name: Waveform Viewer
waveform-view.description: See an audio file's amplitude over time — on your device.

audio-fade.name: Audio Fade
audio-fade.description: Smooth the start and end of a clip with a fade, then export WAV — on your device.

audio-inspect.name: Audio Inspector
audio-inspect.description: How long a recording is, how big, and how heavily compressed — without playing it through.

ui.dropLabel: Choose or drop an audio file
ui.dropTitle: Drop an audio file here, or click to choose
ui.dropReplace: Drop another file to replace this one
ui.dropHint: MP3, WAV, OGG, M4A — anything your browser can decode.
ui.errorDecode: Couldn't decode that file as audio. Try an MP3, WAV, or OGG.
ui.privacy: Your audio never leaves this device — trimming happens in your browser.
ui.inspectDrop: Drop an audio file here, or click to choose
ui.inspectFailed: This file could not be read as audio.
ui.inspectCompared: Uncompressed, this recording would be about {raw}. It is stored at roughly {percent}% of that.
ui.inspectNote: Read from the file's own header on your device — nothing is uploaded and nothing is played to anyone but you.
